why.label: Why Audexon
why.title: Purpose-built for the audit workflow
why.subtitle: Not another project management tool — designed around how audit teams actually work.

f1.title: TB-Driven Structure
f1.p: Upload your trial balance once. Audexon maps classifications to audit sections automatically.

f2.title: ISA 230 Audit Trail
f2.p: Every action logged. Every reopen requires a reason. Immutable, append-only documentation ready for peer review.

f3.title: Bring Your Own Cloud
f3.p: Link your firm's Google Drive or OneDrive for audit working files. Your data and uploads stay encrypted and access-controlled in Audexon's secure cloud.

f4.title: Review From Anywhere
f4.p: Partners see every section’s status, review notes, and sign-offs from one dashboard.

f5.title: Three-Level Sign-Off
f5.p: Preparer → supervisor → partner. Clear permissions. Every action locked and logged.

f6.title: Team Assignments & Progress
f6.p: Assign sections, track completion in real time, exchange review notes inline.

modal.title: New Engagement
modal.safeTitle: How Audexon keeps your data safe
modal.safe1: Your audit working files stay in your own Google Drive or OneDrive.
modal.safe2: Audexon stores what you enter or upload — trial balance, procedures, findings, review notes, and FS documents — encrypted in its secure cloud.
modal.safe3: Only your firm's authorised team members can access your engagements.
modal.safe4: Your data is protected with strong encryption at all times — whether it's being sent or stored.
modal.safe5: You always own your data — Audexon simply helps you manage the audit work securely.
